title: Human Pancreas Optical Clearing by iDISCO and VISIKOL
author: Martha Campbell-Thompson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ba4qigvw
materials: Using the Antibody solution as a diluent, prepare the primary antibody cocktail and incubate the samples for 48 hours at room temperature. Primary and secondary antibodies are listed in the JOVE publication. We utilized cocktails of primary and secondary antibodies, combining primaries raised in mouse, rabbit, goat, and chicken and suitable secondary antibodies raised in donkey (ThermoFisher, Jackson Immunoresearch).

steps.title: PBS wash of fixed tissue
steps.instruction: On a shaker, wash the fixed tissue twice for 30 minutes each in 1 X PBS at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: First 30‑minute wash in 1 X PBS, room temperature, shaking.
Second 30‑minute wash in 1 X PBS, room temperature, shaking.

steps.title: Methanol dehydration series
steps.instruction: Dehydrate the tissue in methanol at room temperature using 50 %, 80 %, then 100 % MeOH, incubating 1 hour in each concentration.

substeps.instruction: Incubate 1 hour in 50 % MeOH, RT.
Incubate 1 hour in 80 % MeOH, RT.
Incubate 1 hour in 100 % MeOH, RT.

steps.title: Peroxide/DMSO methanol treatment
steps.instruction: Place the tissue in a solution of 5 % H₂O₂, 20 % DMSO in MeOH and incubate overnight on a shaker at room temperature.

steps.title: DMSO/MeOH washes
steps.instruction: Wash the tissue twice for 1 hour each in 20 % DMSO/MeOH at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: First 1‑hour wash in 20 % DMSO/MeOH, RT.
Second 1‑hour wash in 20 % DMSO/MeOH, RT.

steps.title: Reverse methanol gradient
steps.instruction: Wash the tissue in decreasing methanol concentrations (100 %, 80 %, 50 %) for 1 hour each at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: 1 hour in 100 % MeOH, RT.
1 hour in 80 % MeOH, RT.
1 hour in 50 % MeOH, RT.

steps.title: PBS‑Triton X‑100 incubation
steps.instruction: Place the tissue in 1 X PBS containing 1 % Triton X‑100 and incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Penetration buffer incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples in Penetration Buffer for 36 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Blocking buffer incubation
steps.instruction: Transfer the samples to Blocking Buffer and incubate for 36 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash after blocking
steps.instruction: Wash the samples in Wash Buffer five times for 30 minutes each at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: First 30‑minute wash in Wash Buffer, RT.
Second 30‑minute wash in Wash Buffer, RT.
Third 30‑minute wash in Wash Buffer, RT.
Fourth 30‑minute wash in Wash Buffer, RT.
Fifth 30‑minute wash in Wash Buffer, RT.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Using Antibody solution as diluent, prepare the secondary antibody cocktail and incubate the samples for 48 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Post‑antibody washes
steps.instruction: Wash the samples in Wash Buffer five times for 30 minutes each at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: First 30‑minute wash in Wash Buffer, RT.
Second 30‑minute wash in Wash Buffer, RT.
Third 30‑minute wash in Wash Buffer, RT.
Fourth 30‑minute wash in Wash Buffer, RT.
Fifth 30‑minute wash in Wash Buffer, RT.

steps.title: Methanol re‑hydration series
steps.instruction: Wash the tissue in increasing methanol concentrations (50 %, 80 %, 100 %) for 1 hour each at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: 1 hour in 50 % MeOH, RT.
1 hour in 80 % MeOH, RT.
1 hour in 100 % MeOH, RT.

steps.title: HISTO‑1 incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples in HISTO‑1 solution for 16 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: HISTO‑2 incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples in HISTO‑2 solution for 16 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Mounting for imaging
steps.instruction: Mount samples on glass slides in HISTO‑2, place a #1.5 coverslip using silicon spacers, or alternatively use glass chamber slides or a small imaging dish.

substeps.instruction: Place sample on glass slide, add HISTO‑2 as mounting medium.
Cover with #1.5 coverslip using silicon spacers.
Optional: use glass chamber slide or small imaging dish instead of standard slide.

steps.title: Imaging
steps.instruction: Image the cleared samples using a confocal microscope or a suitable lightsheet system.
